items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: Mose Allison was one of the most different people that I ever played with.

ctx.x: Well see but he was borderline folk. He was, in fact if it hadn’t been for Mary Lou I don’t know how I played with him, because he’s unique. He’s one of a kind. He has his own notation for his own stuff. And if you look at it and compare it to your usual way of analyzing it wasn’t that, I just had to go ahead and play. Okay. Mose Allison was one of the most different people that I ever played with. And one night I was there and I guess Bill Lee would have sent me to the Top of the Gate, I was playing with him. I…
Well we’ve talked for over an hour here.
